author: SavageAmericans
body:
It has been a while fellow Avicians! I will (hopefully) be playing more on the server. I have an idea how to make it so people can vote and people have to play to use their rewards.

If you vote you get free 2x credits for a day!

Consecutive voting for a month.

5 days: 3x credits instead of two
10 days: same as 5 days
15 days: 4x credits instead of 2
20 days: same as 15 days
25 days: 5x credits instead of 2
30 days: 5x credits instead of 2

All time voting chance extra prizes!
1/50 better credits multiplier (1x more)
1/100 Free random shop item (that you do not own)
1/10,000 free gold rank or free rankup!

title: Voting Ideas!

replies.author: RIP_Avicus
replies.body: The voting for credit multipliers will limit the benefits of donating even further, and we had a thread about voting before I believe, and, overall, I think we got negative feedback to it.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
^^^^^
Yeah after 30 days, a diamond would be earning 25 credits per kill and 250 per monument, whereas a new player without a rank and without voting would earn 2 credits per kill and 20 per monument.

I'd suggest things like:
1/100 chance to win X perk for lobby
1/20 chance to win X number of X gadget for lobby
1/100 chance to win a free badge color change
1/20 chance to win 250 credits
1/50 chance to win 500 credits
After every 5 consecutive votes +100 credits
+1 credit for every kill for th next 2 hours (not affected by rank)
